svg.text: Wave 2 VR4 Intron Retention — Design Panel Overview
44 constructs · VHH27 (cross-species anti-ALPL) · v4 acceptor (CTAAC + GAATCC → PNSSPSPSSSSSQES scar)
Goal: validate >90% splicer · identify dial-down rules to reach 80–90% (10–20% retention)
WAVE 1 DESIGN PRINCIPLES — APPLIED TO WAVE 2
+6=G is a mismatch (0 HB, corrected map)
⑤ No tier bottleneck at T7
Empirical bridge: do natural donors hold up?
Flagship zone; basis for E & F dial-down.
D1: port → v4+VHH27; D2: CAG; D3: AAG
D2: top flagship — permissive + GTAAG + ESE.
Panel B donors, +6 flipped T→G (~10–15 pp).
W1 T1 always non-permissive; unexplored gap.
GT→GC + AG→AA on top B/D candidates.
Strategy: Panels B & D establish splicing ceiling → Panels E & F apply controlled dial-down → Target: 80–90% splicing, 10–20% retention
Total: 44 constructs across 7 panels · All VHH27 · v4 acceptor · AVD002 backbone · FLASH synthesis (AgeI/BsrGI)
